title: THE PICKUP STACK SHOWS SIX ROWS
why: His answer 36: the pickup stack should show more rows. What you pick up shows as rows on the right edge above the gun card, and it held only the last four, so a quick run through a room pushed the first pickups off before you had read them. It now holds six rows. Each row still lives four seconds, the newest is at the bottom and the same item picked up again still adds to its row.
now: The pickup stack on the right edge now shows six rows instead of four.

edits.replacement: var PICKN=6, PICKLIFE=4;   // v27.xx (pickrows), HIS ANSWER 36 (2026-10-13): "the pickup stack gets MORE rows". Six rows, were four; each still lives four seconds, newest at the bottom
